**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **No commitment on us:** §6.0 (p0720) obliges purchases only "[s]ubject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement" and does not authorise MSL to produce or deliver absent an order; §11.2(d) (p0882) is explicit that forecasts "do not obligate IBM to purchase any Product."
- **Exit exists:** §6.1 (p0722) lets us cancel any and all Purchase Orders at any time, with no cancellation charge where MSL is in default.
- **No flexibility take-or-pay:** §13.2(e) (p0927) — "IBM will have no liability for unused flexibility."
- **Noted, not flagged:** Appendix 2 / §13.0(f) (p0903, p1189–p1191) requires us to compensate MSL where requirements accuracy falls below the threshold, as a percentage of material cost of shipped volume. This is a capped reliance true-up, not a volume floor or shortfall penalty, so it sits within the rule; the redacted percentages should be confirmed commercially.
